PlayerMock.luau.description: In-memory stand-in for a Roblox `Player` used by tests. A real `Player` cannot be `Instance.new`'d and no client joins a headless Open Cloud test place, so this builds a `Folder` that carries the marker and identity attributes production code reads -- letting a "player" flow through guards and providers without a real join.
